    Monte Carlo power for the PPI mean estimator

    simulate_power_ppi_mean.Rd

    Monte Carlo power for the PPI mean estimator

    simulate_power_ppi_mean(
  R,
  n,
  N,
  alpha = 0.05,
  delta = NULL,
  var_f = NULL,
  var_res = NULL,
  moments = NULL,
  seed = 1,
  family = stats::gaussian(),
  theta0 = 0
)

    Arguments

    R

    Integer, number of Monte Carlo draws.

    n

    Labeled sample size.

    N

    Unlabeled sample size.

    alpha

    Two-sided test level.

    delta

    Effect size \(\theta - \theta_0\).

    var_f

    Variance of the predictor \(f(X)\).

    var_res

    Variance of the residual \(Y - f(X)\).

    moments

    Optional list with entries delta, var_f, and var_res.

    seed

    RNG seed (set to NULL to skip seeding).

    family

    A stats::family() object (gaussian() or binomial()), default is gaussian().

    theta0

    Null hypothesis value \(\theta_0\).

    Value

    A list with empirical and analytical power, average standard error, and simulation details.
